name: Mirages
summary: In the Badlands, Sigrun Ironhew's party has fled the Uldaman excavation and gone hungry.

sections.title: Hungry in the Badlands
sections.body: Sigrun Ironhew and her party fled the Uldaman excavation site in a rush. They left wagons and supply crates behind, and ogres from Camp Kosh have been picking through them. The ogres took the cart with all the party's weapons. Since then, the party has had no food. Sigrun admits the trouble is embarrassing and asks you to retrieve the supply crate.

sections.title: On Your Return
sections.body: When you return, Sigrun admits to swallowing a mouthful of sand while you were away. The evening brings a better prospect. Tonight, the party will go out to find food and eat like kings.

faq.answer: Sigrun Ironhew is with a party that fled the Uldaman excavation site in a hurry and now has no food in the Badlands.
Ogres took the cart carrying all the party's weapons. Since then, Sigrun's party has had no food.
Ogres from Camp Kosh have been picking through the equipment left behind.

faq.q: What is Sigrun hoping to get back?
faq.answer: Sigrun hopes to get back the supply crate left behind when the party fled the excavation site.

angles.text: As an Alliance member, you can help Sigrun Ironhew.
